fluff.overview:
Taurian infantry reflect the Concordat's citizen-soldier tradition, with national service requirements ensuring that most adults have received basic military training before ever donning a uniform. Foot platoons form the garrison backbone of the TDF's infantry arm, cheap to equip and maintain on worlds where the Concordat's limited resources must stretch across dozens of systems. Since infantry regiments rarely rotate offworld, many battalions train as specialists in local terrain, and anti-BattleMech training is standard for all formations at battalion strength or greater.

Equipped with laser rifles that offer superior range and armor penetration compared to ballistic weapons, these platoons field one of the most effective personal arms available to conventional infantry, though the weapons are significantly more expensive and require soldiers to carry additional power packs.
